title: feat(app-shell): console lists link names that point at another object's record (objectui#12673)
body:
Fixes #12673
Clause-②: no

Ruling `6216810282`, letter A: the console list host publishes the same any-object record links the record page holds. Lookup cells and `referenceVia` cells in every console list now link to the target record. A plain click opens it in the console; Ctrl-click, ⌘-click or a middle click opens a new tab.

## First step: measurements (base `15d8ca6`)

1. **Can the list host reach the routable-object set the detail bridge reads? Yes.** AppContent mounts `ObjectView` and `RecordDetailView` with the same `allObjects` prop, and `ObjectViewInner` already reads `appName` from the route params. The bridge needs exactly those two inputs. The premise holds.
2. **Click areas in a dense grid.** An in-cell link covers its own text only. Live on HotCRM at 1280 px, the account link measured 155 x 16 px inside a 180 x 41 px cell, inside a 1199 x 41 px row. The rest of the row stays the row's click. Two independent guards keep a link click from also opening the row: the anchor's own `stopPropagation`, and data-table's row handler, which ignores targets inside an anchor. The primary link column masks the host for its children, so no anchor nests in an anchor (the objectui#11817 rule; live nested-anchor count on the opportunities list is 0).

## What changed

- **One builder, shared.** `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` exports its existing record-path builder as two pure functions: `routableObjectNames(objects)` and `appRecordPath(appName, routable, objectName, recordId)`. The bridge's own `recordPath` now calls them and still appends its `?from=` trail. The record page behaves the same, and a CONTROL test pins it.
- **List host.** `listRecordActionsValue` takes an optional `routes` argument (appName, objects, navigate, routerRootHref). With it, a record of ANOTHER routable object gets the record page's route `/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID`. It is published as a document href through the existing `documentHref` join, so a new tab or a copied link carries the console's base path. A plain click navigates by router path. No `?from=` entry is added, because a list page has no parent record. The listed object keeps its own route and its own record navigation, which carries the list as the record's origin. A non-routable object, a missing app segment or an empty id answers no href, so the cell renders plain text.
- `ObjectView` passes the routes: the route's `appName`, its `objects` prop, `useNavigate()` and `useHref('/')`.
- **No change in plugin-grid or fields.** `RecordPointerCell` and the lookup cell's `ReferencedRecordLink` already draw an anchor whenever the host answers.
- **Targets that cannot be opened.** An unreadable or missing record-pointer target keeps its 'record unavailable' face and draws no anchor. A lookup whose target the server does not serve draws nothing. An object the console cannot route to stays plain text.
- No metadata key, no spec change. Nothing new is reachable from the `@object-ui/app-shell` package entry: `src/index.ts` and `views/index.ts` export only `ObjectView` and `ConsoleObjectViewProps` by name, and `package.json` exports only `.`.

## Live evidence (HotCRM, 1280 px)

Screenshots are on the evidence branch `claude/issue-12673-evidence` (commit `cb648c3c`), which is never merged here:

- Opportunities list, account lookup, focus on the first account link: [light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/cb648c3ca12ef6446b9fdc92cae839b08d740ea3/docs/design/findings/12673/opportunities-account-light.png?raw=true) · [dark](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/cb648c3ca12ef6446b9fdc92cae839b08d740ea3/docs/design/findings/12673/opportunities-account-dark.png?raw=true)

## Tests (on `1a00c21`)

- `__tests__/listCrossObjectCells-12673.test.tsx` (8): real `ObjectGrid` and cell renderers under the real `listRecordActionsValue`, fed by the router's `navigate` and `useHref`, basename `/_console`. React-router's `Link` is the href oracle. Covers:
  - a lookup cell to another object (href, left click, row click not fired);
  - a modifier click left to the browser;
  - a `referenceVia` cell (href and click);
  - an unreadable or missing pointer target keeps its unavailable face with no anchor;
  - a lookup with no value served draws no anchor;
  - a non-routable lookup target draws no anchor;
  - a row click outside the link opens the row's own record;
  - one anchor per cell, none nested.
- `ObjectView.listCrossObjectHost-12673.test.tsx` (6): the real `ObjectView` publishes the builder. The list href path equals the record page's href path (one builder). CONTROL: the record page keeps its `?from=` trail and its null answer for an unroutable object.
- `ObjectView.listRecordHref.test.ts`: 7 new builder cases. The old 'no other object' case now pins the no-routes path.
- Ablations: each pin was mutated once, went red, and was restored with the HEAD blob hash compared and `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - Host stops passing routes: 3 red. Host answers no other object: 7 red. Shared builder drops the routable check: 4 red. Record page drops its trail: 1 red. Grid drops the row click: 1 red. Pointer cell links an unreadable target: 1 red.
  - Removing the lookup link's `stopPropagation` alone stays green, because the row handler's anchor guard catches it too. Removing both guards turns the lookup pin red.
- Full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite as 12 sequential shards of the same file set (a single run outlives this container's command cap): 1461 files (1 skipped), 13774 tests passed, 9 skipped, 0 failed.
- `type-check` exit 0 (after building the dependency closure); eslint on touched files exit 0 (0 errors); `build` exit 0 (dist completeness ok); `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:new-line-citations` and `check-changeset-presence` all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- A record of another object opened from a list carries no way-back entry. The listed object's own row open still does.
- A lookup cell holding a raw id it could not name still links, exactly as on the record page (the objectui#8695 face). The target page answers deleted and not-visible alike, so this does not reveal whether a record exists.
- `pageRecordActionsValue` (custom pages) still holds its own copy of the same route builder, and the `documentHref` docblock still names two hosts. Both are outside this change's file surface and are left as they are.
